
I did not write this file to disk. I have no file-system access in this session, so please save the block above to `/home/dev/d43b05/app/notes/same-frame.json` yourself. The values come from the declarations alone, not from running the library. The declarations show that `interpolateArcRotateCamera` has no documented rejection path, and no abort signal is passed, so `rejects` is `false`. `finalRadius` is 7 because the goal has no `radius`, so the tween leaves the radius alone and your synchronous `camera.radius = 7` stands. `finalTargetX` is 1 only if the library copies `goal.target` when the call is made. The declarations don't say whether it does. If it reads `spot` on each frame, the value will be 5, so I'd move the `spot.x = 5` line or pass a fresh target object rather than rely on that.
